mechanism_narrative: The four-week drop in WORKPLACES mobility signals weakening commuter traffic; within one to four weeks this reduces lunch, errand, and after-work shopping trips, pushing RETAIL_REC lower than in the prior month.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES fell from -4.3 at t-3w to -0.6 at t-0w after a brief +6.0 rebound, while RETAIL_REC declined from 3.7 to -13.3
failure_condition: If WORKPLACES continues to fall or stay negative but RETAIL_REC averages higher over the next 28 days than over the last 28 days, this mechanism is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in RESIDENTIAL time captures more staying-home behavior; over the next two weeks, that suppresses discretionary outings and keeps RETAIL_REC below its recent average.
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL increased from 4.9 to 9.3 across the snapshot while RETAIL_REC fell from 3.7 to -13.3
failure_condition: If RESIDENTIAL remains elevated but RETAIL_REC does not decline relative to the last 28 days within two weeks, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: When TRANSIT stays below its t-3w level and continues to weaken week over week, access to shopping districts and malls tightens, so RETAIL_REC turns lower within one month.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT falls below 0 and remains negative for 2 consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT moved from 3.3 at t-3w to -8.7 at t-0w
failure_condition: If TRANSIT stays negative for two weeks or more but RETAIL_REC does not underperform its prior four-week mean over the next 28 days, reject the mechanism.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising GROCERY_PHARM trips and falling PARKS mobility indicates substitution toward essential errands and away from leisure outings; over the next four weeks this substitution keeps retail-and-recreation demand depressed.
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM stayed near 49-54 while PARKS dropped from -4.4 to -16.7
failure_condition: If GROCERY_PHARM remains high and PARKS remains low but RETAIL_REC rises above its last-28-day mean over the next month, the interaction hypothesis is false.

mechanism_narrative: If WORKPLACES and TRANSIT both fall sharply at the same time, it signals broad access restrictions or remote-work tightening; this shock reduces discretionary retail visits within one to two weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES and TRANSIT both drop by at least 5 points week-on-week
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES and TRANSIT are both negative at t-0w after recent volatility
failure_condition: If both WORKPLACES and TRANSIT fall by at least 5 points week-on-week but RETAIL_REC does not weaken within two weeks, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: During the winter holiday demand window, elevated GROCERY_PHARM and muted PARKS activity proxy indoor shopping substitution and gift-trip completion; this supports a short-lived rebound in RETAIL_REC over the next week.
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM is persistently high while PARKS is deeply negative
failure_condition: If the holiday-week pattern is present but RETAIL_REC does not improve within 7 days, or continues falling, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: A rebound in PARKS mobility after a trough indicates improved outdoor foot traffic and local circulation; with a lag of about four weeks, some of that movement spills into nearby retail and recreation venues, lifting RETAIL_REC.
candidate_trigger: PARKS turns up for 2 consecutive weeks after a negative trough
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS fell from -4.4 to -16.7 over the four observed weeks
failure_condition: If PARKS stops declining and begins a two-week rebound but RETAIL_REC remains below its prior four-week average over the next 28 days, reject this hypothesis.

mechanism_narrative: When RESIDENTIAL rises while WORKPLACES and TRANSIT both remain weak, the population is spending more time at home and making fewer discretionary trips; that combination should keep RETAIL_REC below its recent baseline over the next month.
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL increased to 9.3 while WORKPLACES stayed near zero and TRANSIT was -8.7 at t-0w
failure_condition: If RESIDENTIAL stays elevated together with weak WORKPLACES and TRANSIT, but RETAIL_REC rises above its last-28-day mean over the next 28 days, the mechanism is falsified.
